text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Sirius. Being able to 
celebrate this day with you every year 
brings me the utmost joy."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For old times' sake, I sent some flowers 
to your room.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I see. As expected of the "Emperor." 
Nothing but flattery and empty 
decorations.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, that's not what I want. You 
already know that, right?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, which is to say— You wish to 'hone 
your skills' against me?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Close, but not quite. It's 'drawn swords 
and bent bows.'

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see. "Dragons struggle and tigers 
fight"—is that what you mean?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. It's purely 'survival of the 
fittest.'

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... It seems no matter how much 
I struggle, "peace and tranquility" simply 
isn't in the cards.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Still, deep down you don't really hate it, 
do you? —Baring your fangs and stabbing 
your enemy in the back.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it. I'll rip that saintly mask 
right off your face in no time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Your strength lies in that 
unyielding will of yours. I must be extra 
careful myself.
